scripts.onboarding: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts && node tools/wallet/onboarding-server.mjs
scripts.owner:setup: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts && concurrently -k -n web,owner "npm run dev:web" "node tools/wallet/onboarding-server.mjs"
scripts.provider:check: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/worker && node tools/provider/check.mjs
scripts.runtime:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/worker && npm run provider:configure && concurrently -k -n api,worker,seller,signer "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "node tools/provider/agent.mjs" "node tools/provider/signer.mjs"
scripts.wallet:deployment-quote: npm run build:packages && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts && node tools/wallet/check-deployment-quote.mjs
scripts.review:live: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/worker && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts && npm run review:live --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts --
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/shared && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/planner && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/wallet && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/worker && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/web && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts
scripts.test:kernel: node -e "if (!process.env.KERNEL_FORK_RPC_URL) throw new Error('Set KERNEL_FORK_RPC_URL before running the fork suite')" && npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts -- nodejs test/Kernel.integration.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.db:generate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate --workspace @guardian-wallet/database
